name: Calls Workflow
description: A declared job calls a reusable workflow (`jobs.<id>.uses: owner/repo/.github/workflows/x.yml@ref`, or `./.github/workflows/x.yml`). The callee brings its own jobs, runners and permissions and receives whatever secrets the caller passes — every one of them under `secrets: inherit`. The pin says whether the caller runs the workflow it reviewed or whatever a name points at today. Emitted only when the callee is on the grid; an unresolved call is recorded on the calling job, never as a fabricated node.

declared_ref.description: The ref as written after `@`; empty for a same-repository call, which takes no ref.

pin_kind.description: `sha` proves itself. `tag` / `branch` only when resolved against the callee repository's refs (in scope). `unresolved` is a mutable name the collector could not classify. `local` is a same-repository call, which runs at the caller's own commit and cannot be repointed independently. `unpinned` is a cross-repository call with no ref, which GitHub rejects but a file can still contain.

is_pinned.description: True iff the callee cannot move under the caller: `sha` or `local`.

resolved_sha.description: The commit the ref resolved to at collection time — the SHA itself, or an in-scope ref's head. Absent when unobservable. Its field history across collections is the drift detection for a `@main` call.

resolution.description: How the pin was established: read off the string; matched against refs of the callee's repository already held; or not looked up because that repository is outside the observed scope.

same_repository.description: The `./` form: callee and caller are one repository. Distinguishes a call whose callee moves with the caller from one whose callee is someone else's file.

secrets_inherit.description: `secrets: inherit` — the caller passes EVERY secret it holds to the callee. The single property that turns a reusable-workflow call into the untrusted→privileged handoff the incident corpus describes. Named secrets, when passed instead, are listed on the calling job's configuration.
